chapter: Learning, lawn parties and band rivalries
title: Chalky Banana learning from Kid Rene; musicians who steal licks
summary: Dawson says Chalky Banana learned trumpet by following Rene's band, and that he hid his chord positions from fellows trying to steal them; Allen mentions 'alligators' and 'goats'.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Different fellas, you know, from different bands, you know, where I was playing. I had guitar players playing at different bands, you know. Go around just like a whole lot. That's where Chalky Banana learned how to play trumpet. How do you think Chalky Banana learned how to play trumpet by following behind Rene's band. And I was playing with Rene and Chalky didn't know nothing about trumpet. But he used to, he got good with Rene and he'd buy, he know Rene drank wine. He'd get a half a gallon of wine, you see. And drink it on the job, give it to Rene. And Rene would, he'd go sit up on the music stand right next to the band by Rene. And Rene would be showing him the fingers, fingers, how the finger would chop it. And Chalky would be taking it in. They would give him, giving him instruction of what that notes was and different vowels. Finally, Chalky got so he could, he could pray. And he got to be good. You see most of Chalky prays? All in Rene is style. You can notice that. You see he was, have you noticed when Rene was playing trumpet, he was a good trumpet player. Chalky Banana had all the style of Rene, while learning from him, you see. And a lot of fellas learned stealing. I could call that stealing. Going around and looking at fellas playing. Now I seen, I had a whole lot of them used to try to steal from me when I was playing. Get, get, get tall. But when I was good on a guitar, I had a way I could, I got, I could make a chord up here in the first position. And I could make that same chord down there 12th. You see. Cause I'd just be running off and down that neck, you know. When he be looking for me up there, I'd be way down there. Make the same compliments right down in that one thing there. Hard to catch on. I knew he was after stealing, you see. That's why I used to do that.
What did you call the guys that would steal? Nothing, nothing.
Just trying to get, trying to get by on the top top. Not paying for instructions, you know. Yeah.
